CDP partner site — ezEMRx overview page. Rich detail: ONC-ACB certified, built for public health, mobile iOS access, HIE portal, integrated PM with sliding fees, optional RCM, SOC 1/2 Type 2 certified.
CDP EHR detail page. Patient records management, clinical documentation, mobile access, reporting by CMS/NCQA standards, Meaningful Use compliance.

Detailed feature list: medical/social/behavioral/substance abuse history, immunization registry, drug interactions, treatment plans, scheduling, household management, inventory with barcode scanning, sliding fees, claims scrubbing, patient portal, time tracking, credit card processing.

EMR page: appointment scheduling, registration, HIE, dashboards, immunization registry, coding optimization, eligibility verification, electronic claims submission, denial alerts, auto-adjudication, patient statements.

Clinic software page: complete medical history including behavioral health and substance abuse, drug interaction info, treatment plans, customizable templates/questionnaires/task lists, remote care, integrated eligibility verification, merchant services.

System overview: captures physical, behavioral, and substance abuse data for vulnerable populations. Lists full feature set including complex billing engines, auto-adjudication, bar code scanning inventory.
CDP portfolio overview: Data Direct analytics, ezEMRx EHR, CDPims environmental health, WIC solutions. Shows ezEMRx as one component of CDP's public health technology ecosystem.

December 2020 press release: COVID-19 mass vaccination features added — batch tracking, community drive setup, QR code self-registration, attendance monitoring. CDP implemented in 1,000+ US locations. Siri Kumar identified as CTO/CEO.

BillFlash/NexTrust integration: pre-visit billing via email/text, electronic bill notices, mailed statements, payment reminders, StoredPay/AutoPay/PlanPay, patient financing (FlexPay). Claims 60% increase in payments within 30 days.
